q1.explanationZh: replace 及物动词“取代”，replace ... with/by ...“以……代替……”。

q2.explanationZh: reply 既是动词也是名词“回答”，reply to ...“对……作出回答”。

q3.explanationZh: report 动词“报告；报道”，名词“报告；成绩报告单”。

q4.explanationZh: report 加 -er 表示人，reporter“记者”。

q5.explanationZh: represent 及物动词“代表”，represent the company“代表公司”。

q6.explanationZh: represent 加 -ative 构成 representative，作名词“代表；代理人”。

q7.explanationZh: republic“共和国”，the People's Republic of China“中华人民共和国”。

q8.explanationZh: reputation“声誉；名气”，a man of good reputation“信誉很好的人”。

q9.explanationZh: request 动词、名词同形，“要求，请求”，request sb. to do“请求某人做……”。

q10.explanationZh: require“需要；要求”，require sb. to do sth.“要求某人做某事”。

q11.explanationZh: require 加 -ment 构成名词 requirement“要求；需要”。

q12.explanationZh: rescue 动词、名词同形，“营救”。

q13.explanationZh: research“研究”，作名词时不可数；研究人员是 researcher。

q14.explanationZh: resemble 及物动词“像”，后面直接接宾语，不加 to 或 with。

q15.explanationZh: reserve“保留；预订”，名词 reservation“预订”。

q16.explanationZh: residence“住处；居住”，与 resident“居民”同词根。

q17.explanationZh: resident“居民”，结尾是 -dent；residence“住处”结尾是 -dence。

q18.explanationZh: resign“辞职”，注意 g 不发音；名词 resignation。

q19.explanationZh: resist“抵抗；忍住”，resist doing sth.“忍住不做某事”。

q20.explanationZh: resist 加 -ant 构成形容词 resistant“抵抗的；耐……的”，be resistant to ...。

q21.explanationZh: resist 加 -ance 构成名词 resistance“反抗；抵制”。

q22.explanationZh: resolution“决心”，make a resolution“下决心”，动词是 resolve。

q23.explanationZh: resolve“决定；解决”，resolve to do sth.“决心做某事”。

q24.explanationZh: resort“度假胜地”，a holiday resort“度假胜地”。

q26.explanationZh: respect 名词“尊敬；方面”，动词“尊重”，in some respect“在某些方面”。

q27.explanationZh: respect 加 -ive 构成形容词 respective“各自的”。

q28.explanationZh: respective 加 -ly 构成副词 respectively“分别地”，常放在句末。

q29.explanationZh: respond“回答；作出反应”，respond to ...“对……作出反应”。

q30.explanationZh: respond 的名词是 response“回答；反应”，in response to“作为对……的回应”。

q31.explanationZh: responsible 去 -le 加 -ility 构成名词 responsibility“责任”。

q32.explanationZh: responsible“负责任的”，be responsible for“对……负责”，反义词 irresponsible。

q33.explanationZh: rest 名词、动词同形，“休息”，take a rest“休息一下”。

q34.explanationZh: replace A with/by B“用 B 代替 A”，介词用 with 或 by。

q35.explanationZh: reply 是不及物动词，回答某人或某事要加 to：reply to ...。

q36.explanationZh: a man of + 名词表示“具有……的人”，a man of good reputation“信誉很好的人”。

q37.explanationZh: request sb. to do“请求某人做……”，后接不定式。

q38.explanationZh: request sth. of sb.“向某人请求某物”，介词用 of。

accept: resist the urge to do sth.
resist the urge to do sth

q39.explanationZh: resist“忍住，抑制”，the urge to do sth.“做某事的冲动”。

accept: be required to do sth./for sth.

q40.explanationZh: be required to do sth.“必须做某事”，也可以说 be required for sth.。

q41.explanationZh: holiday“假日”+ resort“胜地”，a holiday resort“度假胜地”。

q42.explanationZh: require sb. to do sth.“要求某人做某事”，后接不定式。

q43.explanationZh: “满足要求”可用 meet、satisfy 或 fill 搭配 one's requirements，requirements 用复数。

q44.explanationZh: give/pay one's respects to sb.“向某人问候”，respects 用复数。

q45.explanationZh: “方面”用 respect：in all respects（复数）或 in every respect（单数）。

q46.explanationZh: in respect of“就……而言；关于”，介词用 of。

q47.explanationZh: show respect to sb.“对某人表示尊敬”，respect 作名词。

q49.explanationZh: “乔治接替爱德华出任队长”，replace“取代”，叙述过去的事用过去式 replaced。

q50.explanationZh: “描述事故”的是人，用 reporter“记者”。

q51.explanationZh: be requested not to do sth.“被请求不要做某事”，被动语态用过去分词 requested。

q52.explanationZh: “受人尊敬的科学家”，用过去分词 respected“有威望的”，highly respected“备受尊敬的”。

q53.explanationZh: take (full) responsibility for ...“对……负（全部）责任”，full 后接名词 responsibility。

q54.explanationZh: “营救工作受阻”，rescue 作定语修饰 attempt，the rescue attempt“营救行动”。

q55.explanationZh: has been + 过去分词构成现在完成时的被动语态，research 作动词“研究”，用 researched。

q56.explanationZh: “我已为你预订了房间”，have + 过去分词 reserved 构成现在完成时。

q57.explanationZh: “城市居民抱怨”，谓语 complain 是复数形式，所以用 residents。

q58.explanationZh: resist the urge to do sth.“抑制做某事的冲动”，could 后接动词原形 resist。

q59.sampleAnswer: The two kids were rewarded with a box of crayons and a book respectively.
references: The two kids were rewarded with a box of crayons and a book respectively.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q59.explanationZh: “得到……作为奖励”= be rewarded with ...；“分别”= respectively，放在句末。

q60.sampleAnswer: Why have you never made any reply to what I asked?
references: Why have you never made any reply to what I asked?

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: “回答”可用 make a reply to ...，reply 作名词；“我问的问题”可译为 what I asked。

q61.sampleAnswer: The more thoroughly you collect information, the more persuasive your report will be.
references: The more thoroughly you collect information, the more persuasive your report will be.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “越……越……”= the + 比较级 ..., the + 比较级 ...；“有说服力的”= persuasive。

q62.sampleAnswer: A dozen interviewees, including beginners and professionals, said they were enthusiastic about rock climbing because it required them to solve problems creatively.
references: A dozen interviewees, including beginners and professionals, said they were enthusiastic about rock climbing because it required them to solve problems creatively.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: “需要某人做某事”= require sb. to do sth.；“热衷于”= be enthusiastic about；including ... 表示“包括……”。

q63.sampleAnswer: News came that all the people suffering from the flood were rescued.
references: News came that all the people suffering from the flood were rescued.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “得救”用被动语态 be rescued；that 引导同位语从句说明 news，从句较长，所以放到 came 后面。

q64.sampleAnswer: Whether you will resign next month or not, it's essential to do well in the work at hand, as it reflects your character.
references: Whether you will resign next month or not, it's essential to do well in the work at hand, as it reflects your character.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “无论是否……”= whether ... or not；“离职”= resign；“当前的工作”= the work at hand。

q65.sampleAnswer: The new job is better paid, but in some respect less interesting.
references: The new job is better paid, but in some respect less interesting.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “在某些方面”= in some respect；“报酬更丰厚”= better paid；“不太有趣”= less interesting。

q66.sampleAnswer: While developing economy, we must pay attention to saving resources and preventing pollution.
references: While developing economy, we must pay attention to saving resources and preventing pollution.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “在……的同时”= while doing；“注意做某事”= pay attention to doing，to 是介词，后接动名词；“资源”用复数 resources。

q67.sampleAnswer: Don't be afraid of getting caught in the rain, as it's time to see whether your new overcoat is resistant to the rain.
references: Don't be afraid of getting caught in the rain, as it's time to see whether your new overcoat is resistant to the rain.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “防雨的”= resistant to the rain；“淋雨”= get caught in the rain；“是时候做某事了”= it's time to do sth.。

q68.sampleAnswer: All the senior three students are required to have a routine physical check-up before they take the college entrance examination.
references: All the senior three students are required to have a routine physical check-up before they take the college entrance examination.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: “必须做某事”= be required to do sth.；“例行体检”= a routine physical check-up；“高考”= the college entrance examination。
